predictions.question: R&D gaps S1/S2.3 (BOM): what source brightness does counted implantation at 1 ion/ms into a nanometre spot require, and is space charge at array scale a limit?

model.brightness: I = B * (pi r^2) * (pi alpha^2) for spot radius r and convergence half-angle alpha. Required current for counted writing = e/tau_shot (tau=1 ms, Exp65 center). Spot cases: sigma_spot 2 nm (Exp66 EUV-grade spec; r=2 nm), 5 nm (relaxed); alpha in {5, 10, 30} mrad.
model.source_classes: Registered literature-scale brightness anchors (assumptions, not measurements): plasma/duoplasmatron ~1e1..1e2, LMIS ~1e6 A/m^2/sr class.
model.space_charge: Total array current at 1e6 beamlets and Child-Langmuir extraction limit J_CL = (4 eps0/9) sqrt(2e/m_P) V^1.5/d^2 for d=1 mm, V=10 kV, aperture area per beamlet at 10 um pitch.

predictions.success_rule: Some registered spot/alpha case reaches 1 ion/ms with brightness at or below the LMIS anchor 1e6 A/m^2/sr, and space charge is not the binding limit (array current < 1% of the Child-Langmuir total).
predictions: AT1 PLASMA INSUFFICIENT: At sigma=2 nm, alpha=10 mrad, required brightness exceeds 1e4 A/m^2/sr (above plasma class).
AT2 LMIS ENOUGH: The same case is within the LMIS anchor 1e6 A/m^2/sr.
AT3 RELAXED SPOT HELPS: At sigma=5 nm, alpha=30 mrad, required brightness drops by more than 30x vs the AT1 case.
AT4 SPACE CHARGE MINOR: Total array current at 1e6 beamlets is below 1% of the Child-Langmuir extraction total.

design_consequence: BOM S1.1 class changes: plasma source insufficient; LMIS/cold-ionization high-brightness source required.
